**The reviews, and what was taken.** The design (plan §4.8) was read by the cross-model reader before any Lean: 25 findings, every one taken ([REVIEW-RFM3](../../development/rf-formations-that-read/evidence/REVIEW-RFM3.md)), among them that net agreement suffices for the answer to be least but is much stronger than needed, that a shared valuation with the weights apart does not keep informing from lowering the worth, an exact criterion over every refinement in reach, the threshold of withholding against informing and the four one-decision alternatives, the carrier's maps and timing, the unshown case from one start with inputs alike, and the readings brought to what the papers state; the module was renamed `ListingValuation` and "shaping" became "revaluing". The module as first built (105 theorems in 145 declarations) was reviewed on the Lean by the cross-model reader, fifteen findings, and through three lenses, exactness (seventeen), structure (twenty) and sources (fourteen), each lens's findings judged by a verifier, 49 real and two not ([REVIEW-RFM3-LEAN](../../development/rf-formations-that-read/evidence/REVIEW-RFM3-LEAN.md)). The module was revised on all of them and rebuilt at 129 theorems in 177 declarations: the induction stated on agreement only at the acts emitted; informing's graded bound; the criterion over every refinement with factoring on both listings, and a counterexample to factoring on one; the cost thresholds through a refinement and with a shared model and net agreement; a filter and a revaluation commuting as updates and not as courses; reachability under the supplied update not asserted where a revaluation gains; names made structural, the readings marked. Three Opus readers then checked from the files how each lens finding was reflected: 44 taken and 7 in part, six of which were completed, four with nine declarations (informing's strict form, the coarser answer forgoing no less never above the finer, the told criterion with no cell list, the least shortfall through what is shown, the course forms of the two turning cases) and two in prose (the off-switch Readings citing `undemonstrated_worth`, structural titles), while a link to the off-switch paper stays in part, withdrawn for the re-check's point that a constant answer can give the better move. The cross-model reader's re-check found no mathematical error and nine points in prose, every one taken, and its check of the final delta two omissions in the header, both taken. The module stands at 138 theorems in 186 declarations, every axiom report empty.

**The cold read of the texts.** Before the landing, the texts were cold-read against the module by the cross-model reader, six points and one more from its re-check of them, every one taken, and then through three lenses, exactness, readings and fit: 64 findings, each lens's judged by a separate reader, 54 confirmed and 10 refuted; every confirmed finding was taken, two refuted ones were taken all the same as clearer and harmless, three were met by the changes for confirmed ones and five left as they stand ([REVIEW-RFM3-COLDREAD](../../development/rf-formations-that-read/evidence/REVIEW-RFM3-COLDREAD.md)). The module's statements are unchanged; its header, one docstring and one section heading were revised and it was rebuilt, 138 theorems in 186 declarations, every axiom report empty. The cross-model reader then re-checked how they were taken, and three Opus readers, one per lens, each with a refuter, checked the same: one omission and 14 gaps, every one judged real, 12 distinct points, all taken, among them the worth of an answer alike stated only where no demonstration tells apart the worlds the holding formation lists or none is emitted and the shared model stated with the loss by the current valuation; the header was revised again and the module rebuilt, the same counts. The cross-model reader's third re-check found nothing, and beside it two Opus readers, one checking how those points were taken and one reading the new texts cold, each with a refuter, found 11 gaps, every one judged real, 9 distinct points, all taken, among them the shared model stated where the module states the revised answer's lack of residual, the worth stated of the worlds the holding formation lists and the record's incentive to withhold read as possible; the header and the docstring of `outcome_least` were revised and the module rebuilt again, the same counts. Then the cross-model reader's fourth re-check found nothing, and one Opus reader found every point taken and nothing new in the texts, only an absolute path left on the review page, made relative.

**Self-review.**
1. `ListingValuation` imports `HeldForReading`, a core module, so it joins the core as a leaf at L1, and `HeldForReading` is no longer a leaf.
2. The totals reuse the package's `Flow` lemmas (`total_add`, `total_congr`, `total_le`, `total_pos`, `total_pos_of_mem`, `le_total_of_mem`, `total_mul`, `lt_iff_pos`), `total_congr_on` (Population), `total_eq_zero` (Dissipation), `HeldForReading`'s cells laws (`total_by_cells`, `total_cond_both`, `cell_term`, `offPart`, `shortfall_through`, `least_through`, `finer_least_le`, `across_le_iff`, `across_lt_iff`), the prelude's core forms (`add_sub_of_le`, `add_right_cancel`, `le_of_add_le_add_right`, `le_of_add_le_add_left_core`, `SupportGated.sub_pos_of_lt`), `Narrowing`'s filter lemmas and `ListTests`'s Boolean lemmas; comparisons are decided by `Nat.decLt`, with no `omega`, no `simp` and no `funext`, one subtraction lemma restated (`lt_of_sub_pos_core`) because the library's carries `propext` and the package has none, and the witnesses evaluate by `rfl` or `decide` on natural-number and two-valued candidates (literals of `Fin` carry `propext`). The strict-total lemma `total_lt_of_mem` repeats `Loops.total_lt`, and `cond_zero_le` repeats `Weighting.term_le_of`, both outside the import closure; one statement of each is left to its module's owner.
